name: Mavorixafor

fda.text: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Embryo-fetal toxicity: Expected to cause fetal harm. Advise women of reproductive potential to use effective contraception. ( 5.1 , 8.1 , 8.3 ) QTc Interval Prolongation: : Correct any modifiable risk factors, assess QTc at baseline and monitor QTc during treatment as clinically indicated.…

examples.title: Addition of X4P-001 to Nivolumab Treatment in Participants With Renal Cell Carcinoma
examples.why: Due to low enrollment, the study was terminated early.

summary: Official warnings state that Mavorixafor is expected to cause harm to an unborn baby, so women who can become pregnant are advised to use effective birth control [3]. The drug also carries a warning for QTc interval prolongation, which is a delay in the heart's electrical cycle that requires monitoring and correcting certain risk factors [3]. Additionally, results from a small computer model, rather than tests on people, estimated a low risk score of 42 for the liver and a medium risk score of 64 for the heart [M].
